name: Knock Knock
source:
Someone wants Millie dead, but first, she has to play a game of Knock Knock with the man pulling the strings from behind the phone.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Knock_Knock]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
有人想要米莉死，但首先，她必须与从电话后面操纵的男人玩敲门游戏。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Knock_Knock]Choices Wikia[/url]]
